## Submission rules

These rules are printed on every homework sheet.

- Deadlines are hard: the upload form closes at noon and there are no extensions.
- Type the answers, create a PDF and upload it on the form. Only PDF files are accepted.
- Name the file `{branch}_{roll_number}_{name}.pdf`.
- Put all code and Jupyter notebooks in **secret** [GitHub gists](https://gist.github.com/) and link them in the PDF.
- Cheating and plagiarism are not tolerated.
- Cite all pertinent references in IEEE format.
- The least count of grading is 0.5 marks.
- The course VM is linked from the [home page](index.qmd).

The sample code for random page replacement mentioned in Homework 2 is [`code/replacement-random-plot.py`](code/replacement-random-plot.py).
